THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 06.01.2026, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2026:KER:445 WP(C) NO. 48579 OF 2025  2  P. V. KUNHIKRISHNAN, J.
 ---------------------------------------
 W. P. (C) No. 48579 of 2025  ----------------------------------------
 Dated this the 6th day of January, 2026  JUDGMENT

The above Writ Petition (C) is filed with the following prayers:
"i.
To issue a writ of certiorari calling for records relating to Ext P9 and quash the same.

ii. To issue a writ of mandamus, order or direction directing the 1st respondent to allow the petitioner to continue the functioning of catering unit based on Ext P5 certificate and not to insist for any certificate from any government authorities.
iii. To dispense with the production of translation of vernacular documents.
iv. Such other reliefs this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper to grant in the facts and circumstances of the case."

[SIC]
2. The petitioner challenges Ext.P9 order.
Admittedly, Ext.P9 is an appealable order.
Therefore, I am not inclined to entertain this writ petition.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that a breathing time may be given to file the appeal.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Writ Petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to challenge the 2026:KER:445 WP(C) NO. 48579 OF 2025 impugned order in accordance with law.
Status quo as on today shall be continued for a period of two weeks.
